name: Love Love Otokonoko Ryou ~Boku o Ubaiau Otokonoko to Otokonoko
original_name: ラブラブオトコの娘寮 ～僕を奪いあうオトコの娘とオトコの娘
source:
In the spring of that year--- Keiichi's younger brother enrolls in the same school as him -- as a trap! Madly in love with his older brother, while searching the internet finds an  internet trap idol and decides to copy him.  "I'm going to be my older brother's girlfriend!" But would you believe it -- the person that is with his brother is the very trap idol he was copying! He was his older brother's classmate! What are to traps to do but to fight over the boy they love. So the classmate proposes a battle to prove that they are the one most suitable for Keiichi.

Sparks fly between the two rivals as Keiichi sighs only to find his younger brother going for his crotch! And like this, a strange new term starts.
translation:
那年春天——敬一的弟弟以伪娘的身份转入了他的学校！他疯狂地迷恋着哥哥，在网上搜索时发现了一个网络伪娘偶像，决定模仿他。“我要成为哥哥的女朋友！”但你能相信吗——和他哥哥在一起的人正是他模仿的那个伪娘偶像！他是哥哥的同学！两个伪娘只能为争夺心爱的男孩而战。于是那位同学提出了一场对决，以证明谁最适合敬一。

两个对手之间火花四溅，敬一叹了口气，却发现弟弟正在摸他的裆部！就这样，一个奇怪的新学期开始了。
